Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ إِذَا سَأَلَهُ عَبْدٌ أَعْطَاهُ
Translation: O One who, when a servant asks Him, He gives

Arabic text: وَإِذَا أَمَّلَ مَا عِنْدَهُ بَلَّغَهُ مُنَاهُ
Translation: And when one hopes for what He has, He grants their wish
And when one turns to Him, He brings them near and close

Arabic text: وَإِذَا جَاهَرَهُ بِالْعِصْيَانِ سَتَرَ عَلَى ذَنْبِهِ وَغَطَّاهُ
Translation: And when one openly disobeys Him, He conceals their sin and covers it
And when one relies on Him, He suffices them and fulfills their needs

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ مَنِ الَّذِيْ نَزَلَ بِكَ مُلْتَمِسًا قِرَاكَ فَمَا قَرَيْتَهُ
Translation: My God, who has come to You seeking Your hospitality and You have not hosted them?

Arabic text: وَمَنِ الَّذِيْ أَنَاخَ بِبَابِكَ مُرْتَجِيًا نَدَاكَ فَمَا أَوْلَيْتَهُ
Translation: And who has come to Your door hoping for Your generosity and You have not bestowed upon them?

Arabic text: أَيَحْسُنُ أَنْ أَرْجِعَ عَنْ بَابِكَ بِالْخَيْبَةِ مَصْرُوفًا
Translation: Is it appropriate that I return from Your door turned away in disappointment?

Arabic text: وَلَسْتُ أَعْرِفُ سِوَاكَ مَوْلًى بِالْاِحْسَانِ مَوْصُوفًا
Translation: When I do not know any master other than You known for benevolence

Arabic text: كَيْفَ أَرْجُوْ غَيْرَكَ وَالْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ بِيَدِكَ
Translation: How can I hope for other than You when all goodness is in Your hand?

Arabic text: وَكَيْفَ أُؤَمِّلُ سِوَاكَ وَالْخَلْقُ وَالْاَمْرُ لَكَ
Translation: And how can I desire anyone but You when creation and command belong to You?
Shall I cut off my hope from You?

Arabic text: وَقَدْ أَوْلَيْتَنِيْ مَا لَمْ أَسْأَلْهُ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
Translation: When You have already given me what I did not ask for from Your grace
Or would You make me need someone like myself?
While I hold fast to Your rope
O One through whose mercy the seekers find happiness
And by whose vengeance those who seek forgiveness do not become wretched
How can I forget You when You have always remembered me?
And how can I be distracted from You when You are watching over me?
My God, I have attached my hand to the hem of Your generosity
And I have extended my hope to receive Your gifts
So purify me with the sincerity of Your Oneness
And make me among the elite of Your servants

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ كُلُّ هَارِبٍ إِلَيْهِ يَلْتَجِئُ
Translation: O One to whom every fugitive seeks refuge
And every seeker places their hope
O Best One to hope in
And O Most Generous One to be called upon
O One whose petitioner is never rejected
And whose hoper is never disappointed
O One whose door is open for those who call upon Him
And whose veil is lifted for those who hope in Him
I ask You by Your generosity to bestow upon me

Arabic text: مِنْ عَطَائِكَ بِمَا تَقَرُّ بِهِ عَيْنِي
Translation: From Your gifts that which will delight my eye

Arabic text: وَمِنْ رَجَائِكَ بِمَا تَطْمَئِنُّ بِهِ نَفْسِي
Translation: And from hope in You that which will reassure my soul

Arabic text: وَمِنَ الْيَقِينِ بِمَا تُهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيَّ مُصِيبَاتِ الدُّنْيَا
Translation: And from certainty that which will ease the calamities of this world for me

Arabic text: وَتَجْلُوْ بِهِ عَن بَصِيرَتِيْ غَشَوَاتِ الْعَمَىٰ
Translation: And remove from my insight the veils of blindness
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful ones
